exposure: Prenatal diagnosis of supernumerary lateral hemivertebra
outcome: Ultrasonography specifics leading to early and accurate diagnosis
Association with other anomalies (cardiovascular, urinary, skeletal, gastrointestinal, central nervous systems)
cohort: A single case of a fetus diagnosed prenatally with supernumerary lateral hemivertebra.
finding: Early assessment of the fetal spine and diagnosis of conditions like hemivertebrae is important due to their significant association with other anomalies and adverse obstetric outcomes.
mod_finding: Congenital conditions like hemivertebrae are frequently associated with high cesarean delivery rates.
